title: Questionable durability
text:
Questionable durability. Fold seams will wear over time.Bottom ring doesn’t line up properly so each time one opens and closes the rings to add or remove a recipe, the ring has to be hand-adjusted aligned. There is no opening tab either. Rings must be pried apart by hand. Go to Staples and get a better binder!
Then order the labeled recipe category dividers by this brand, which are great! The binder won’t last.

product_metadata.title: Recipe Binder, Full Page 3 Ring Standard Binder Organizer Set (with 50 Page Protectors & 12 Category Divider Tabs) by Better Kitchen Products, 11.5" x 12" Vintage Kitchen Design
features: COMPLETE SET - Comes with an 11.5 x 12" 3-ring binder, 50 clear letter sized protector sheets, and 12 divider pages featuring printed tabs of the most popular recipe categories.
COMPLEMENTING THEME - The binder and divider tabs feature complementary designs

SMART DESIGN - The binder has stain-resistant padded covers and a 2.5" D-shaped ring which allows the binder to stay flat when opened; extra-durable protector sheets feature secure inward opening and have heat-welded seams and double thickness in hole-punched margin
DURABLE - 2.5" D-rings provide high capacity; Secured protectors sheets and divider tabs are wrapped separately for protection and fun and easy set-up.
COOKING TIPS & MEASUREMENTS - Inside front and back covers feature an EQUIVALENT MEASUREMENTS list including standard to metric conversions and EMERGENCY SUBSTITUTE INGREDIENTS list.
